review.summary: Single-hunk fix widening the internal `_bytes` dispatch from `String`/`SubString{String}` to `AbstractString`, so `URIs.escapeuri` no longer throws MethodError for other AbstractString subtypes (e.g. `String15` from InlineStrings, or any user type defining `codeunits`). Issue #42 reports the crash, PR #48 fixes it, and the upstream test patch adds a verbatim regression assertion using a `CustomString <: AbstractString` fixture. Runtime evidence shows a stable differential across 3 repetitions with the full fixed suite passing.
review.evidence: Production patch removes the two concrete-type `_bytes` methods and replaces them with `_bytes(s::AbstractString) = codeunits(s)`. Issue #42 title is `ERROR: MethodError: no method matching _bytes(::String15)`, an outright crash on a public escaping path, not a missing capability request. PR #48 body states `Fixes .../issues/42`. Upstream test in test/runtests.jl asserts `escapeuri(CustomString("http://example.com")) == escapeuri("http://example.com")`, which fails with MethodError pre-fix and passes post-fix. Minimization reports 1 of 1 hunk kept, globally minimal, all hunks necessary. Trigger uses public API only (URIs.escapeuri).
review.missing_evidence: No commit stats or diff line counts supplied, and no captured pre-fix stack trace in the record (the MethodError is inferred from the issue title and the dispatch change). The surrounding `escapeuri` signature is not shown, so I cannot confirm from the provided text that it is declared over `AbstractString`; that would settle definitively whether this is an unhandled case or a widened contract.
review.validation_risks: Classification is arguably borderline: PR title 'Support AbstactString in escapeuri' reads like a capability extension, though no public API or signature is added and the observable symptom is a crash, so I treat it as a dispatch-gap defect. The test fixture `CustomString` implements only `Base.codeunits` and not the full AbstractString interface, so the trigger depends on `escapeuri` touching only the codeunits path; a future refactor calling other AbstractString methods would make the test fail for reasons unrelated to the defect. `codeunits` on an arbitrary AbstractString is not guaranteed to be defined, so the broadened method can shift a MethodError from `_bytes` to `codeunits` for unsupported types, which is fine for this oracle but worth noting.
review.suggested_tests: Keep the upstream verbatim assertion as the F2P test. Add: escapeuri on an InlineStrings `String15` value equals escapeuri on the equivalent `String` (matching the original issue exactly); escapeuri on a `SubString{String}` and a plain `String` to confirm no regression on the previously handled types; escapequery/unescapeuri round-trip on a CustomString input; and a check that `_bytes` on `Vector{UInt8}`, `Base.CodeUnits`, and `SubArray{UInt8}` still dispatch to the unchanged methods.
